display.purpose: The page title only, one per page, left-set; expanded 125% width, uppercase.

statement.purpose: Section headings at 112% width, sentence case.

passage.purpose: A long passage set one phrase per line and grouped by sentence (lines on the line height, sentences 0.9em apart), in Chalk Ink.

lead.purpose: The tagline, short answer lines under a statement and a closing contact line.

role.purpose: Titles inside hairline lists, at 106% width.

body.purpose: Supporting sentences in Ash Ink, held to 28-42ch.

label.purpose: The footer wordmark only, uppercase at 112% width; never a tag above a heading.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Everything that arrives or responds: press scale, arrow lean, relief and still-light fade-in, the lamp's warm-up.

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: The hero lamp's one entrance sweep only.

motion.name: hover-color
motion.purpose: Colour, background and underline changes on hover, fine pointers only.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Primary button and quiet link while pressed.

motion.name: arrow-lean
motion.purpose: Arrows lean toward where they lead on hover.

motion.name: lamp-entrance
motion.purpose: Hero lamp sweeps once from left of centre to rest at upper right.

motion.name: lamp-warm
motion.purpose: Lamp intensity rises from dark to full during the entrance.

motion.name: lamp-spring-pointer
motion.purpose: Hero lamp follows a mouse pointer and returns to rest when it leaves. A pointer that arrives mid-entrance takes the lamp with its momentum: stiffness ramps in over 200ms, critically damped.

motion.name: lamp-spring-scroll
motion.purpose: Band lamp crosses from 8% to 92% of the width with scroll, level with 42% of the viewport height.

motion.name: relief-fade
motion.purpose: The relief appears only after its first frame, so it never pops in.

motion.name: still-light-fade
motion.purpose: The still lamp light fades in when the relief cannot run on a hardware GPU.

motion.name: media-reveal
motion.value: clip-path wipe, 900ms cubic-bezier(0.33, 1, 0.68, 1), edge at 30 degrees
motion.purpose: Media below the fold opens once from its top-left corner, triggered at 88% of the viewport height.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: No lamp sweep, no pointer or scroll following, no reveal, no smooth scroll; the lamp sits at rest at full strength.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one solid fill on a screen: Chalk Ink block, ground-coloured label, square, 3rem tall; brightens to Lit Ink and leans its up-right arrow on hover.
components.html: Write to us
components.css: .ds-btn-primary-stage { padding: 1.5rem; background: var(--ground, #0a0b0c); } .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; min-height: 3rem; padding: 0 1.25rem 0 1.375rem; background-color: var(--ink, #ecebe7); color: var(--ground, #0a0b0c); font-family: var(--font-archivo, Archivo), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-stretch: 112%; font-weight: 560; font-size: 0.9375rem; letter-spacing: 0.01em; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 0; transition: background-color 200ms ease, transform 160ms var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)); } .ds-btn-primary-arrow { flex: none; transition: transform 200ms var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)); } @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) { .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: var(--ink-lit, #f8f5ef); } .ds-btn-primary:hover .ds-btn-primary-arrow { transform: translate(3px, -3px); } } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--lamp, #f0e6d6); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Inline Link

components.name: Header
components.description: A bare header over the field: the mark top left and the contact address top right as a quiet link in Ash Ink, so the address is on screen from the first moment; no bar, background or menu.

components.name: Relief Field (still light)

components.name: Media Reveal
components.description: Media below the fold opens once from its top-left corner behind a hard edge at the 30 degree crease angle (900ms, ease-out); none under reduced motion. Shown on a fall-off placeholder.
components.css: .ds-reveal-stage { padding: 1.5rem; background: var(--ground, #0a0b0c); } .ds-reveal { width: 240px; height: 160px; background: var(--ink-3, #8e9092); -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, #000 72%, transparent 100%); mask-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, #000 72%, transparent 100%); animation: ds-reveal-wipe 900ms cubic-bezier(0.33, 1, 0.68, 1) both; } @keyframes ds-reveal-wipe { from { clip-path: polygon(0px 0px, 0px 0px, 0px 0px); } to { clip-path: polygon(0px 0px, 517px 0px, 0px 299px); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-reveal { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
The page is a matte graphite surface that absorbs light and shows only what one lamp chooses to reveal. On a hardware GPU the ground under the hero and one mid-page band becomes a folded-plate relief, flat facets meeting at zigzag creases that run at ±30°, raked by a single neutral-warm lamp; everywhere else a still pool of the same light rests on the grain in its place. Either way the visitor meets a dark material first and an interface second.

The system is sparse and exact rather than dramatic. One family, Archivo, carries every word, and its width axis does the expressive work: expanded light capitals for the title, slightly widened light statements, normal width for reading. Ink is a tinted neutral in three steps. Content is separated by 1px hairlines and dark space, never by boxes, and the only solid fill on a screen is the primary button. Density is low: wide, fluid gaps of ground between subjects, short measures, nothing competing with the light.

Motion is rationed and mostly belongs to the light. The lamp sweeps in once and settles, follows a mouse on a spring, and travels with the reader through the band; media opens once with a hard wipe cut at the crease angle. Type never moves, and nothing depends on motion, script or WebGL to be read. The system rejects the dark-tech default outright: a centred glowing headline over an orb or particle field, rows of glass cards, a neon accent, and the same fade-up on every section. Discretion is the brand's posture, so the visuals earn credibility through craft and never through claims.
keyCharacteristics: A matte graphite ground under a static 128px grain tile; never flat black.
One neutral-warm lamp, the only light; nothing else glows.
A ±30° crease angle shared by the relief and the media reveal.
Archivo alone; width (125, 112, 106, 100) is the expressive axis and weight stays light.
Hairlines instead of boxes, square corners, no shadows.
Complete and legible with motion reduced, scripts off or no GPU.

rules.name: The One Lamp Rule
rules.body: Light has one source and one colour. The lamp is the only thing on the page that emits light; ink, hairlines and the button reflect it and never glow.

rules.name: The Light-Not-Paint Rule
rules.body: The lamp colour appears only as light (the relief and its still stand-in), as the focus ring and as the text selection. It is never a fill, a text colour, a border or an accent.

rules.name: The Three Inks Rule
rules.body: Text on the ground takes ink, ink-2 or ink-3 and nothing else: ink for what is read first, ink-2 for what supports it, ink-3 for fine print. The one inversion is the primary button, ground on ink. Interaction may raise ink-2 to ink; nothing changes hue.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Archivo alone, from one variable file. Expression comes from the width axis, not from a second typeface: 125% for the title, 112% for statements, labels and controls, 106% for list titles, 100% for reading.

rules.name: The Light Type Rule
rules.body: Large type is light: 300 for the title and statements, 330 for the passage. Nothing is bold or italic; the heaviest weight in the system is the button's 560.

rules.name: The Still Type Rule
rules.body: Type never moves. No fade-ups, typing effects, split letters or scroll-linked text; every word is in the server HTML and visible before any script runs.

rules.name: The Asymmetry Rule
rules.body: Content is left-set on asymmetric splits of the 12-column grid (5 and 7, or a 5-column heading over a passage stepped to columns 6 to 12). Centring is kept for a short interlude: one statement, its lead lines and a narrow image, never a whole page.

rules.name: The Depth-Is-Light Rule
rules.body: Nothing is raised. Surfaces get depth only from the lamp falling across facets and from masks that let forms fall off into the ground.

rules.name: The Still Light Rule
rules.body: When the relief cannot run on a hardware GPU (a software WebGL renderer, no WebGL, or no script), a still radial pool of lamp light sits where the lamp would rest. Content never depends on the relief.

rules.name: The Crease Angle Rule
rules.body: Folds, cuts and wipes run at the relief's 30° crease angle and no other. Don't introduce skews, other diagonal wipes or angled section edges.

rules.name: The No-Box Rule
rules.body: Content is never boxed: no cards, panels, outlined containers or framed images. Separation is a 1px hairline or dark space.

rules.name: The One Filled Control Rule
rules.body: The primary button is the only solid fill on a screen and appears once there; every other action is text with an arrow.

rules.name: The Brighten Rule
rules.body: Interaction only brightens: ink-2 rises to ink, a strong hairline to ink, ink to lit ink, and arrows lean 3px toward where they lead. Nothing changes hue, grows or lifts.

rules.name: The Reveal Once Rule
rules.body: Media opens once and stays open; what the reader can already see is never hidden.

dos: Do keep every surface on the graphite ground with its grain tile, and let the relief or its still light be the only thing that brightens it.
Do rest the lamp away from the type: in the hero it settles upper right while the title sits lower left.
Do separate content with 1px hairlines (line, 12% ink) and dark space, and keep surfaces and controls square-cornered.
Do set every word in Archivo and change width before weight: 125% title; 112% statements, labels and controls; 106% list titles; 100% reading.
Do cut any new fold, wipe or diagonal at the 30° crease angle.
Do ease arrivals and responses with cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), press controls to scale(0.97), and keep hover effects behind `(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)`.

Do make every view complete without motion, script or WebGL: content visible by default, the reveal's hidden state set only by script and only when motion is allowed, the still light in place of the relief.

Do use only approved images or abstract material, lit by the same lamp and falling off into the ground through masks; ship any derived or generated raster with its provenance embedded, and treat client originals in CSS only.
donts: Don't add glow, bloom or halos to type, controls, the mark or images; the only soft light is the lamp on the relief or its still stand-in.
Don't use frosted glass, cards, panels or framed images.
Don't use gradients as decoration (gradient text, gradient buttons, tinted gradient backdrops); a gradient is only ever the lamp's falloff or a mask into the ground.
Don't introduce an accent colour, or use the lamp colour as paint.
Don't add box or drop shadows; depth comes only from light on the relief.
Don't set a centred, glowing headline over an orb or particle field.
Don't animate text into view or give every section the same entrance; only media reveals, once.
Don't set anything bold or italic, or add a second typeface.
Don't add technical detail of the product or invented claims to any visual.
